changes: Replace ReactContext/ReactPromise/codegen with owned Microsoft.UI dispatcher and copied value completion.
Preserve DataPackage SetText/SetContent and GetTextAsync Completed status/error processing.
Add text/queue quotas, empty/non-text handling, cancellation before execution, and terminal close drain.
Public App clipboard service and Source canonical paste-key snapshots; noncanonical synchronous Core editing shortcuts remain a separate W9B-03 consumer.
Port KeyboardUtils key/code mappings and InputKeyboardSource key-state query; remove unused CoreWindow argument and use App SDK UI ownership. Core key packets and editing shortcuts consume the port.

Port AccessibilityInfo::announceForAccessibility UIA notification into the existing App SDK service queue and current Core provider. Propagate HRESULT; only tooltip announcements are supplied, accessibility settings remain pending.

Capture Clipboard.GetContent on the actual UI paste-key turn before asynchronous Source dispatch; retain RNW GetTextAsync completion, cancellation and terminal tracking. Nelyx owns bounded snapshot tokens and key-to-service correlation outside the copied API implementation.

Connect RNW key/code mappings to canonical Core key ingress and Source Focus/HardwareKeyboard using bounded copied identity. Resolve generic modifier side from WM_KEY scan/extended fields on both down and up; preserve keypad positions and NumpadEnter, adapt operation labels and ContextMenu/PrintScreen table gaps. InputKeyboardSource supplies lock state. Original VK label/layout limitations and noncanonical shortcuts remain separate obligations.
originalEncoding: npm package CRLF; pinned Git originals LF; content equality verified after CRLF normalization
